Read-only C matrix using current lichen_frame_parse/write: neither/0x00 accepts+roundtrips (correct); S-only/0x20 accepts+roundtrips (incorrect); SI-only/0x80 rejects -EINVAL; canonical S+SI/0xA0 rejects -EINVAL (incorrect). Root cause: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/frame.c:19/76-85 declares bit 7 reserved rather than SI and frame.c:139-142/183-190 forbids signer/never sets SI. C TX also emits S-only at lichen_link_tx.c:117 and :257. Existing C ctest passes because its signed positives deliberately use stale 0x20/0x21 bytes. C is read-only this phase, so this bead cannot close until C makes bit7=SI, requires exact S==SI parity, parses/writes 8 signer bytes when set, emits 0xA0|mode from TX, and consumes the canonical malformed/vector cases.\n2026-08-26 read-only re-audit: blocker persists exactly. Normative spec/02-physical-link.md §4.2 defines bit7=SI and requires S==SI, with exactly 8 signer EUI-64 bytes when signed. Canonical test/vectors/link_frame_signed_modes.json uses 0xA0|mode (examples llsec 0xA6/0xA3/0xA0/0xA5/0xA2/0xA7). Zephyr C still defines bit7 as LLSEC_RESERVED in lichen/subsys/lichen/link/frame.c:19, rejects it at :76-80, accepts S-only at :83, forbids signer fields on write at :139-142, and emits only bit5 at :183-190. Both production TX paths still construct (mode|0x20) and pass NULL signer at lichen_link_tx.c:113-148 and :256-282. Thus canonical S+SI frames are rejected while noncanonical S-only frames are produced; current C tests are stale/self-consistent. Exact cross-implementation gates were not rerun because current source is conclusively incompatible and C/Zephyr edits are excluded. Leave open/unclaimed until C parses/writes 8 SI bytes, enforces exact S/SI parity, emits 0xA0|mode, and consumes the canonical positive/malformed matrix. No files modified."}
